saints.name: St. Pelagia the Penitent
saints.title: Penitent
saints.shortBlurb: A celebrated dancer of Antioch who turned from a life of sin to a hidden life of penance…
biography: According to an ancient and widely told account, Pelagia was a famous and worldly actress and dancer of Antioch, renowned for her beauty and wealth. Moved by the preaching of a bishop named Nonnus, she was converted, received baptism, and gave away her possessions to the poor.

Seeking to bury her former life entirely, she is said to have withdrawn to a cell on the Mount of Olives near Jerusalem, living in penance and prayer in the disguise of a monk called Pelagius, her identity discovered only at her death. Her story was long cherished as a model of true conversion.
saints.knownFor: Conversion from a life of sin to penitential solitude.
